articles.title: UN agency pauses Hormuz ship evacuation plan after first vessel attack under peace deal
articles.summary: The pause follows a container ship being struck near the coast of Oman on Thursday, with a U.S. official saying that Iran was responsible for the attack.

articles.title: Core inflation rate hit 3.4% in May, highest since October 2023, Fed’s preferred gauge shows
articles.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show a 4.1% annual increase.

articles.title: Trump pledges rapid U.S. response for Venezuela after historic earthquakes kill hundreds
articles.summary: The swift U.S. offer of assistance reflects a degree of diplomatic realignment between the Trump administration and the Venezuelan interim government.

articles.title: Iran warns ships it's 'unacceptable and dangerous' to transit the Strait of Hormuz without their approval
articles.summary: The stern warning underscores Tehran's resolve to retain control over the Strait of Hormuz and to resist transits that bypass its authorization.

articles.title: Factory job cuts in June neared financial crisis and Covid levels, S&P says
articles.summary: Though the firm's manufacturing index ran better than expected for June, it came largely from an inventory rebuild and despite sharp job cuts.

articles.title: U.S. issues sweeping Iran oil sanctions waivers, unlocking billions in revenue for Tehran
articles.summary: The U.S. issued a sweeping rollback of sanctions on Iranian oil, offering Tehran an economic lifeline as negotiations toward a peace deal proceed.

articles.title: Struggling to find a job? Try looking in Nevada
articles.summary: The sparsely populated state known for its world-class casinos and dry climate has been a hiring hot spot.

articles.title: Hormuz relief may not ease the economic toll that's already 'baked in,' analysts warn
articles.summary: Early signs of reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have lifted the most acute threat to global energy supplies but economic damages from the war will take months to unwind.

articles.title: Trump claims Iran deal is 'unconditional surrender,' says his power has 'no limits': Axios
articles.summary: Trump said in an interview with Axios on Thursday evening stateside that he negotiated the deal to prevent the conflict from triggering a global depression.

articles.title: Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75% amid Iran war peace prospects
articles.summary: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted 7-2 to keep rates on hold.

result.content:
UN agency pauses Hormuz ship evacuation plan after first vessel attack under peace deal - The pause follows a container ship being struck near the coast of Oman on Thursday, with a U.S. official saying that Iran was responsible for the attack.
Core inflation rate hit 3.4% in May, highest since October 2023, Fed’s preferred gauge shows - The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show a 4.1% annual increase.
Trump pledges rapid U.S. response for Venezuela after historic earthquakes kill hundreds - The swift U.S. offer of assistance reflects a degree of diplomatic realignment between the Trump administration and the Venezuelan interim government.
Iran warns ships it's 'unacceptable and dangerous' to transit the Strait of Hormuz without their approval - The stern warning underscores Tehran's resolve to retain control over the Strait of Hormuz and to resist transits that bypass its authorization.
Factory job cuts in June neared financial crisis and Covid levels, S&P says - Though the firm's manufacturing index ran better than expected for June, it came largely from an inventory rebuild and despite sharp job cuts.
U.S. issues sweeping Iran oil sanctions waivers, unlocking billions in revenue for Tehran - The U.S. issued a sweeping rollback of sanctions on Iranian oil, offering Tehran an economic lifeline as negotiations toward a peace deal proceed.
Struggling to find a job? Try looking in Nevada - The sparsely populated state known for its world-class casinos and dry climate has been a hiring hot spot.
Hormuz relief may not ease the economic toll that's already 'baked in,' analysts warn - Early signs of reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have lifted the most acute threat to global energy supplies but economic damages from the war will take months to unwind.
Trump claims Iran deal is 'unconditional surrender,' says his power has 'no limits': Axios - Trump said in an interview with Axios on Thursday evening stateside that he negotiated the deal to prevent the conflict from triggering a global depression.
Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75% amid Iran war peace prospects - The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted 7-2 to keep rates on hold.

result.summary:
# Economic News Summary

Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are disrupting global trade and energy markets, with Iran warning against unauthorized Strait of Hormuz transits and attacking commercial vessels, though the U.S. has issued sweeping sanctions waivers worth billions to Tehran as peace negotiations progress. U.S. inflation remains sticky with the core PCE index hitting 3.4% in May (the highest since October 2023), while manufacturing job cuts in June reached near financial crisis levels despite better-than-expected inventory gains. The Trump administration is offering rapid humanitarian aid to Venezuela following devastating earthquakes and is actively negotiating a peace deal with Iran to prevent potential global economic disruption, while the Bank of England held rates steady at 3.75%.
